text:
Alex: :rotating_light: Heads up — we're seeing a rapid GPU pod failure cluster in us-west2 starting ~1862345600. Latency spikes for gen endpoints and a handful of pods reporting OOM+NVLink errors. Traffic load is normal but available GPU capacity has dropped ~38%.
Maria Ops: copying. Any networking flaps or just node-level?
Alex: node-level — racks 7-9 on hostpool-w2 are showing repeated kernel oops and the autoscaler isn't freeing spot preemptions fast enough. Control plane still healthy.
Tyler: attaching short logs I grabbed: ```kernel: GPU 0: ECC error, resetting
kubelet: eviction threshold reached, eviction_count=3
nvlink: device reset failed
```
Leah (oncall): oncall here. Prioritize prod endpoints: we need to throttle noisy customers and shift background batch jobs. Can we do per-customer fairshare in the router?
Tyler: yes — we have a rate-limiter config we can push. Plan: (1) apply fairshare at ingress for text-gen (2) pin high SLA customers to dedicated pool (3) route low-priority/large-batch to eu fallback or quantized vm models.
Maria Ops: +1. Recommend immediate soft caps: 60% of normal qps for non-SLA customers, burst=10 requests per minute. Also enable prefix KV caching for chat routes to reduce token generation.
Alex: which customers are top noisy right now? I see acct-0427 and acct-9836 spiking token usage.
Paul: I can message account teams. acct-9836 is running a training loop unwisely; they're already on a support ticket. Recommend immediate per-customer throttle on acct-9836 to 30% of prior allocation.
Tyler: executing change now — infractl policy apply <<EOF
- target: router://text-gen/us-west2
  action: fairshare
  params: {default_qps_factor: 0.6, burst: 10}
- target: customer://acct-9836
  action: throttle
  params: {qps_factor: 0.3, enforcement: hard}
EOF
deploy-bot: policy-change deployed to router/us-west2 by tyler at 1862345805.
Leah (oncall): verify fallback routing for non-SLA: tyler can you confirm eu-west2 capacity & model variants?
Tyler: checked — eu-west2 has ~25% spare capacity if we move low-memory quantized variants. I'll set a region-route for transformable requests: route policy = prefer: eu-west2, model_family: quantized-a*
Maria Ops: also recommend enabling per-route token cap to avoid runaway long-completions: set max_tokens_per_request=512 for gen endpoints for next 2 hours.
Alex: applied token cap and updated throttles. Observability: adding temporary dashboard with customer-level qps and rejection rates.
Jenny CS: pinging impacted account reps for acct-0427 and acct-9836, noted reduced throughput. They expect degraded perf but accept during incident.
Paul: logging note — billing/quotas team flagged acct-0427 for sudden spikes; will coordinate follow-up.
Leah (oncall): good. Next actions: (#1) monitor error rates and tail latency for 15m windows (#2) if capacity doesn't recover, escalate to capacity re-provision (redeploy hostpool-w2 across racks) (#3) prepare communication for affected customers.
Alex: status update in 10m. Current recovery: CPU/infra metrics show slow decline in evictions, token cost down ~28% after throttles. :white_check_mark:
